newsitem.title: USA: UroMed Corp adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: UroMed Corp adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: UroMed Corp said Thursday its board has adopted a shareholder rights plan including special purchase rights should any new group or individual acquire 15 percent or more of company stock.
The company said the plan is designed to give the board of directors flexibility in the event of an unsolicited or hostile merger or acquisition attempt.

"Our Board believes that UroMed's current stock price does not adequately reflect the value of our multiple technologies and market opportunities," chairman and chief executive officer John Simon said in a statement.
Simon said UroMed was not aware of any proposed acquisition of the company but was responding to increased levels of acquisition activity in the healthcare industry.
The Plan will be described in greater detail in a letter that will be sent to all stockholders and on Form 8-K to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
